# Registry Tests — init default, registry list, use, commands-from-outside-kb
skip 'registry-default addressing removed; explicit-addressing rework pending'

# Initialize first KB
exec akb init kb-one
stdout 'Initialized KB .kb-one. at .* and set as default'

# Verify registry lists it as active
exec akb registry
stdout '^\* kb-one .*kb-one$'

# Initialize second KB
exec akb init kb-two
stdout 'Initialized KB .kb-two. at .*'

# Verify registry lists both, kb-one still active
exec akb registry
stdout '^\* kb-one .*kb-one$'
stdout '^  kb-two .*kb-two$'

# Switch default to kb-two
exec akb use kb-two
stdout 'Default KB set to ''kb-two'' at .*kb-two'

# Verify kb-two is now active
exec akb registry
stdout '^  kb-one .*kb-one$'
stdout '^\* kb-two .*kb-two$'

# Write a page from inside kb-two
cd kb-two
stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write my-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/my-note.md'

# Go outside both KBs and verify commands still work via registry default
cd ..

# Read from outside KB using registry default
exec akb read notes/my-note.md
stdout 'Note content.'

# List from outside KB
exec akb list
stdout 'notes/my-note.md'

# Search from outside KB
exec akb search test
stdout 'notes/my-note.md'

# Status from outside KB
exec akb status
stdout 'Name: kb-two'

# Switch back to kb-one
exec akb use kb-one
stdout 'Default KB set to ''kb-one'' at .*kb-one'

# Verify kb-one is now the default for commands
exec akb status
stdout 'Name: kb-one'

# Try to use non-existent KB
! exec akb use nonexistent
stderr 'kb ''nonexistent'' not found in registry; use ''akb registry'' to list available kbs'

# Empty registry should show message
# We can't truly empty the registry without deleting the file, but we can test the message
# by creating a fresh HOME and running registry there.
# Instead, let's verify the registry command works with empty entries by creating a new HOME:
mkdir empty-home
env HOME=$WORK/empty-home
exec akb registry
stdout 'No KBs registered. Use .akb init <name>. to create one.'

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Registry Test Note
summary: A test note
tags: test
---
Note content.
